verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs have a dedicated webhooks page that pitches webhooks as the alternative to polling for asynchronous status changes and account-holder updates (adyen-docs-3, adyen-docs-17). Supporting evidence covers the surrounding pieces: a Customer Area log of webhook events (adyen-docs-45), webhook payment-outcome messages in the Google agentic flow (adyen-supp-google-ucp), and MCP tools to list, get and test webhooks (adyen-supp-mcp-tools). Missing for 10: details on event types and how to configure a subscription or select events, signature/HMAC verification and retry behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration.
